description: Static world objects of map6_s03 (Sewer to Lakeside Amusement Park): 7 objects, drawn in file order. An object is drawn while the player is in one of its "zones" (each {"x": [...], "z": [...]} lists 40 m cells along that axis: cell c holds 40c..40(c+1) m; no zones = everywhere) and every flag of "flags_set" is set and every flag of "flags_clear" is clear (event flag names, e.g. the pickup flags). "name" is the object's id for scripts and mods, "model" its model (at most 8 characters, the map's or an item model), "position" in metres and "rotation" in degrees (x, y, z). "pose" instead takes position and rotation from a table of the map's overlay on the disc ("disc_table" from tables.json, row "index"), resolved when the map loads; pickups use it. "script": true lets world_objects.lua and events.lua move, turn, re-model or hide the object. "pc_near_pickup": true (not in the original) also draws the pickup while the player is in a neighbouring cell of the same floor. Floor/FloorAfter: the original's zone is every x <= 0 (any z); the map's geometry has that only in x cell -1. Sitai sways by world_objects.lua. A mod's maps/map6_s03/world_objects.json changes or adds objects by name.
